expected_observable_behavior.zh: 所有信号在各自工况内平稳，仅有噪声与极轻微老化。
expected_observable_behavior.en: All signals stable within their regimes; only noise and negligible aging.

expected_health_response.zh: 全部部件 NORMAL，不应产生报警。

abstention_cases.zh: 无强制弃权；空闲/停机窗口不评估健康状态。
abstention_cases.en: No mandatory abstention; idle/stopped windows are not assessed.

abstention_cases.zh: 无失效数据：失效概率/RUL 必须返回不支持（NO_FAILURE_EVIDENCE）。
abstention_cases.en: No failure data: failure probability/RUL must return unsupported (NO_FAILURE_EVIDENCE).
